title: cissus rostrata
intro: Cissus rostrata, commonly known as Devil's Claw Creeper, is a type of plant that belongs to the Vitaceae family and is native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including arthritis, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, providing relief from pain and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Cissus rostrata include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include harpagoside, harpagide, and other iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
